content.title: Where to Stream the 2026 Oscar Nominees
content.text: How to watch Sinners, Bugonia, One Battle After Another, and more right now The 98th Academy Awards ceremony will be held on Sunday, March 15, which means you only have a few days to shut yourself in your house and binge all the movies you can, just so you can agree or disagree when the winners are announced. Thankfully, most of this year's Oscar nominees are now available at home to stream. Sinners (which you definitely already saw in theaters, right?) broke records with a whopping 16 nominations going into this year's ceremony. You'll need HBO Max to watch the Ryan Coogler vampire drama, but Netflix will allow you to watch the most Oscar-nominated films, including Frankenstein, Train Dreams, and KPop Demon Hunters. To watch all the nominees, you are also going to need Peacock, Hulu, and Apple TV. There are also quite a few Oscar nominees that haven't made it to streaming yet, at least not without having to pay a rental or purchase fee. Don't worry, we have links for those as well! The guide below runs through all the major Oscar nominees by category so that you can be the most researched person in your Oscar pool this year. We're rooting for you. Here's how to stream the 2026 Academy Award nominated films.
